description: 读取 linux.do(Discourse 论坛)最新话题列表(标题/回复数/点赞/浏览/链接)。先落到 linux.do 域,再在页面内同源 fetch /latest.json——公开内容免登录即可读,登录态会带上 cookie 并规避 Cloudflare 拦截。

steps.fn: async () => { const r = await fetch('/latest.json', { credentials: 'include' }); const t = await r.text(); let d; try { d = JSON.parse(t); } catch (e) { throw new Error('linux.do 返回非 JSON(被 Cloudflare 拦或需登录),请在持久浏览器里正常访问/登录该站后重试'); } const list = (d && d.topic_list && d.topic_list.topics) ? d.topic_list.topics : []; return list.map(x => ({ title: x.fancy_title || x.title, replies: Math.max(0, (x.posts_count || 1) - 1), likes: x.like_count || 0, views: x.views || 0, created: x.created_at, url: 'https://linux.do/t/topic/' + x.id })); }
